title: Speed Life
description: Grian’s Life series, but you go zoom.
body:
### You have 6 Lives. Thats it.
You start off slow, but get faster with every life. 

Each live, you have a different colored name
> 4+ Lives you have a Dark Green name,
> 
> 3 Lives you have a Lime name,
> 
> 2 Lives you have a Yellow Name,
> 
> 1 Lives you have a Red Name.

If you run out of lives? well your gone.... 

Good Luck.
